title: Pre-Bid Document Analysis with AI
summary: Use AI to analyze drawings and specs before deciding to bid. Identify how many issues exist, generate pre-bid RFI questions, and understand project
body_markdown:
### Example Pre-Bid Questions from AI Findings


- 1


**Material Specification Conflict**


"The storefront elevation shows hollow metal frame, but Specification Section 08 41 00 requires aluminum frame. Please clarify which material applies."


- 2


**Dimension Discrepancy**


"Detail 3/A401 shows storefront dimensions of 5½ x 3¾, but page 189 of the specifications explicitly calls for 4½ x 2. Please confirm dimensions for pricing."


- 3


**Code Reference Concern**


"General notes reference IBC 2015 code. Will this project be permitted under current 2024 code requirements? This affects several details."
